title: Threshold-Safe Shock Absorption in a Compartmental Voter-Flow Model:\ A Conservative Impulse-Control Benchmark
summary: We formulate a deterministic threshold-safety problem for a reduced compartmental voter-flow model. An exogenous load enters an alienation reservoir; between releases the reservoir recovers exponentially. Near the mainstream baseline the compartmental dynamics have a linear-stability threshold \(Δ_c\): below this level the mobilised component contracts, while above it transient amplification is possible.
